chunks: And by this chain of transmission, he said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever praises his believing brother to his face but backbites him behind his back — the bond of protection ('isma) between them has been severed.

key_terms.اغتابه: Backbited him — ghiba, speaking about a person's faults in their absence
key_terms.العصمة: 'Isma — the bond of protection, inviolability, or mutual sanctity between believers
key_terms.مَدَحَ: Praised, commended — used here to describe outward flattery

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about praising someone to their face but backbiting them?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad warns that hypocritical behavior toward a fellow believer — praising them face-to-face while slandering them in their absence — severs the sacred bond ('isma) between them. The term 'isma refers to the mutual sanctity and inviolability that exists between believers. This teaching, transmitted through Shaykh al-Saduq's Amali, underscores the Shia emphasis on the coherence of inner and outer conduct as a marker of true faith.
